description: This file defines the JobTitleDao class in the OrangeHRM system, providing database access methods for job titles, including retrieval, filtering, creation, deletion, and related data handling.

classes.name: JobTitleDao
classes.description: Data access object for handling Job Title related database operations within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active job titles, optionally filtered by active status.

methods.name: getJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves job titles associated with a specific employee identified by employee number.

methods.name: getJobTitles
methods.description: Fetches job titles based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getJobTitlesPaginator
methods.description: Internal method; returns a paginator for job titles based on search filters.

methods.name: getJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of job titles matching filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Marks job titles as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Fetches a specific job title by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingJobTitleIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing job titles given a list of IDs.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Fetches a JobSpecificationAttachment by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobTitle
methods.description: Persists a JobTitle entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Removes a JobSpecificationAttachment entity from the database.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationByJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves partial information about JobSpecificationAttachment by job title ID.
